blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A resolution congratulating Filipino gymnast Carlos Yulo’s historic double-gold finish at the 20th Asian Games has been filed at the Senate. Sen. Bam Aquino filed Senate Resolution No. 689 on September 26, 2026 to commend Yulo’s most recent feat in the international sporting event. “Carlos Edriel ‘Carlos’ Poquiz Yulo made history as the first Filipino gymnast to win an Asian Games gold medal, earning a score of 14.666 in the individual floor exercise and an average score of 14.599 in the individual vault, thereby securing two gold medals at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026,” Aquino wrote in […]...
